# NOTITIES_P_WERELD: zone-3 map revamp (branch 110-p-wereld, worktree guhs_vadsrijk/p-wereld, from e5ab2935e = 110-k-int)

Brief: the agent prompt (P-WERELD) + `../Z3_BRIEF.md` + `../G_BRIEF.md`. The new map = the approved revamp renders
(`renders-schemerwortel2/_bron`) + the user's adjustments (design doc round 20).

## For p-verhuis (and everyone reading Z3WereldPlekken): the ids

**POI v2 is published**: `POI_Z3.md` + `Z3WereldPlekken.java` (generated by `tools/vadsrijk/zone3/poi3.py`).
**Connected world layout (coordinator, 2026-11-05; `guhs1100-avontuur/wereldindeling/WERELDINDELING.md`):** zone 3 sits at
trunk **(1404, -576)** (moved by -896, -576), x 1024..1727, z -1024..-129, tiles tx 16..26, tz -16..-3 (154 tiles). ONE
offset in `plan3.py`: `TX_STAM, TZ_STAM = 1404, -576` (world = rel + offset; not mirrored). `Z3WereldPlekken.STAM_X/STAM_Z`
follow it. The map build deletes every older zone-3 tile (v1 grid tx 25..46 / tz -11..10 and the revamp's first place
tx 29..42 / tz -7..6). **Integration: zone 4 (tx 27..39, tz -12..-5) overlaps the v1 grid, so build zone 4's map AFTER zone 3.**
- No water ring any more (`bouw3.zee` and its 6 rescue wind columns `wind_zee_*` are gone); edges are natural: root capes
  (`boom2.LOBBEN`) under the two piers + a small one south, 30 extra long hanging roots on the west side (into the Wolkenkloof).
- Harbours: the **Weststeiger** (west pier on a long Honingtak branch tip at 184 deg) = the existing `dok_*` ids (line B from
  zone 2's Galmdok arrives here; `DOK_LANDING`/`DOK_BEL`), and the **Oosttaksteiger** (east pier, branch tip at 19 deg) =
  new `oosttaksteiger_mast/_landing/_bel/_kapitein/_luchtschip` (line C to Lampionhaven). Both at deck level (stand 167, the md
  says y ~170). Lookouts U4/U5/U6 = new `uitkijk_westtak`, `uitkijk_nest`, `uitkijk_oosttak` (in `UITKIJKEN`).

- **Disappeared:** none. Every v1 id still exists (444 ids now, v1 had 388), at its new place.
- **Renamed:** none. Some ids keep their old name but now mean the closest new place (table below).
- **New ids:** `trap_bordes_1..6` (a stand spot on each landing of the inner stair: floor 80, Honingtak 166, kruin 1/2/3, nest),
  `rijpad_start`, `rijpad_honingplein`, `rijpad_eind` (riding spiral), `binnenhof` (the round deck in the hollow trunk at the
  Honingtak landing, where the two trunk lifts meet), `honinglift_kruin_boven/_onder` (Honinglift B, Honingtak -> kruin 1; also in
  `LIFTEN` as `honinglift_kruin`), `kabelbrug_begin/_eind`, `pelszaal_trap_boven` (top of the stair down to the Pelszaal),
  `raatweide_plein`, `molenhoek_plein` (beekeeper villages), `kamp.1..3` (ground camps), `schorshuis.1..16` (the houses in the
  trunk wall along the stair), `gebouw.woning_9.*`, `gebouw.raattros.npc`, `oosttaksteiger_*`, `uitkijk_westtak/_oosttak/_nest`.
- **New lists** in `Z3WereldPlekken`: `SCHOORSTENEN` (chimney tops: smoke particles), `BIJENKORVEN` (bee swarms), `LICHTJES`
  (night glow spots), `BRUGGEN` (guhs on bridges). Plus the usual `GEBIEDEN`, `MOBZONES`, `PADEN`, `WINDKOLOMMEN`, `LIFTEN`,
  `KAMPVUREN`, `UITKIJKEN`, `DOK_LANDING/BEL`, `RESPAWN`.

### Old name, new meaning
| v1 id(s) | now |
|---|---|
| `hangnest_*` (Hangnest Dauwdrup) | **Imkerdorp Zoemrust** on the Bijentak (herberg/lusje/winkeltje = its 3 houses, plein = branch top) |
| `hangnest_woning_1..3` / `4..6` | the houses of **Imkerdorp Raatweide** (Zuidwesttak) / **Molenhoek** (Molentak) |
| `mosvoet_*` | **Mosvoet**, a small ground hamlet by the foot of Honinglift A (south-east) |
| `honinglift_*` | **Honinglift A** (ground -> Honingtak, Lifttak tip) |
| `schorslift_1` / `_2` | lifts in the hollow trunk: floor 81 -> binnenhof 167 / binnenhof 167 -> kruin-1 landing 233 |
| `lift_cafe/kapel/raattros` | small lifts from the deck down into the 3 big honeycomb cells under the Honingtak deck |
| `spiraal_*` | the riding spiral (outside): `spiraal_voet` = start, `spiraal_top` = end on kruin 1, balconies = glide jumps |
| `spiraal_poort_75/128` + `schorsstad_poort_75/128` | the two ground gates into the Schorsstad (south / north): outside / inside end |
| `spiraal_poort_176` + `schorsstad_poort_176` | the Honingtak door of the stair (outside on the deck / inside on the landing) |
| `schorsstad_ring_1..7` | spots on the inner stair beside the 7 Lantaarntoren rings (y 92..152) |
| `arena_piepvel` + `piepvel_*` | the **Pelszaal is UNDER the Schorsstad floor** (stand 61, r 16), stair down from the floor |
| `arena_kruinroofvogel` (Kale Kruin) | a dead mesa sticking out of kruin 1 (south-west, stand 226); perches on the Bijentak + Noordtak tips |
| `wind_*` | `werf_tak` Westtak->kruin 1, `hangnest` Bijentak->kruin 1, `paddenbloesem_tak` Zuidwesttak->kruin 1, `spiraal_kruin` Molentak->kruin 1, `mosvoet_kruin` kruin 1->2, `lichtkever_kruin` kruin 2->3, `honingtak` ground->Honingtak deck |
| `wortelgewelf` + `uitkijk_wortelgewelf` | the big ground ruin (north-west) with a lookout |
| `lichtkeverbos` / `schimmelboerderij` / `paddenbloesemdal` / `honingmoeras` | ground quadrants N / W / S / E of the island |
| `hart_*`, `arena_wortelwurger/nestwachter/baron_bleu` | the Hart dungeon is a ring of rooms r 112, floor stand 29, round the Wortelduister hall; `hart_poort` in the hall's west wall; walking order = fight order |
| werf | its own island NE (centre 2551, -251): Dok 1 Taleggio (ground, 168), Dok 2 Brokkel (tower, 192), Dok 3 Roquefort (mast tower, 224) |
| `valbrug` / `lianenbrug` | where the riding spiral meets the Westtak / Noordtak |
